structured_output.title: Internal ACME implementation change affects active cert-manager
structured_output.content: This environment runs cert-manager with active Certificate CRDs (certificates.cert-manager.io v1), indicating ACME certificate automation is in use. The change replaces cert-manager's ACME protocol library with a local fork, which could affect certificate renewal timing, challenge behavior, or ACME authority interactions. Inspect the release notes for any breaking changes, behavioral differences, or specific ACME-related fixes in the fork that might require configuration adjustments.
